_comment: Built-in drivers and detection fingerprints. Optional drivers will come from the helios-drivers catalog (phase 2). See docs/drivers.md.

manual.label: Manual checklist
manual.desc: Describe a switch or access point; HeliOS writes the setup checklist for it. Works with any hardware.

local-ports.label: Router ports
local-ports.desc: Use the router's own extra Ethernet ports (or its switch chip) as access ports, trunks or the WAN port.

lldp.label: Neighbour discovery (LLDP)
lldp.desc: Listens for switches and access points announcing themselves on the trunk. Read-only.

nut.label: UPS (Network UPS Tools)
nut.desc: Battery status, alerts and a clean shutdown for USB UPSes from most brands. Can share the UPS with other machines.
